[[File:Anshar.png|alt=Red fox running on a background of yellow.|thumb|Sign of House Anshar]]
'''House Anshar''' is one of the 19 Major [[:Category:Noble houses|Noble houses]] of [[Andor]]. Its [[High Seat]] is [[Karind Anshar]]. 

==House Sigil==
The sigil of House Anshar is a red running fox on a field of gold or yellow.{{ref/book|twotc}} 

==Activities==
'''[[Succession Wars|Fourth Succession War]]'''- House Ashar initially supported [[House Marne]] against [[House Trakand]], but when the army beseiging [[Caemlyn]] was defeated, House Anshar quickly transferred its support to House Trakand.{{ref/book|11|33}}
